$comment: Text pool for the Depression/Anxiety prayer category.
requests: Peace for my anxious mind. This week has been a lot.
Asking for prayer as I start counseling next week. I am nervous.
My teenage daughter has been struggling with anxiety at school. Some mornings she cannot make herself go. Pray for courage for her and wisdom for us.
I have been in a heavy season for a few months now. Nothing is wrong exactly, but everything feels harder than it should. Pray for light and energy to return.
Sleepless nights have become normal for me. My mind will not slow down. Pray for rest and for God's peace to quiet my thoughts.
A good friend of mine has been battling depression for a long time. She is getting help, but she is tired. Pray for hope and for small good days.
My husband has been withdrawn and down since he lost his job. He is starting to see a counselor. Pray for healing and for him to know how loved he is.
Panic attacks have started showing up at work. I am embarrassed and scared. I see my doctor this week. Pray for calm and for the right help.
Would you pray for my son? He is in college and has been struggling with anxiety and loneliness. He is far from home and I feel helpless.
I am finally admitting I need help with my anxiety. I have an appointment with a Christian counselor next Tuesday. Pray I would be honest and open.
For a coworker who has seemed so down lately. I do not know what is going on, but I want to be a good friend. Pray for her and for me to know how to help.
Every year around this time my mood drops, and this year it has hit harder. Pray for joy to return and for me to keep reaching out instead of pulling away.
My mom has struggled with depression most of her life. She is in a low season again. Pray for her medicine to work, and for our family to be patient and kind.

I have always been the one who helps everyone else, so this is hard to write. For the past few months, I have been dealing with anxiety I cannot shake. I wake up with my heart racing and spend most days just trying to get through. I started counseling last month, and it is helping a little. Pray for steady progress, for good sleep, and for me to believe that God is with me in this.

Our 15-year-old son has been struggling for most of this year. He stopped hanging out with friends, his grades dropped, and he says he just feels tired all the time. We finally got him in with a counselor, and he likes her, which feels like a small miracle. Pray for him to keep going, for us to know how to support him, and for his younger sister, who is worried about him.
details: Some days are better than others, and we are learning to be thankful for the good ones.
Pray for patience and gentleness for everyone involved.
It helps to know people are praying, even when it is hard to talk about.
Good rest would help so much. Nights are often the hardest.
We are trying to take things one day at a time and not rush it.
Pray for the right people to come alongside at the right time.
Hope feels small right now, but it is still there, and we are holding on.
Thank you for praying without needing all the details.
answers: A little lighter this month. Thank you for praying.
Things are slowly getting brighter. Thank you for praying with us.
Still some hard days, but more good ones than before. God is faithful.
Not fixed, but there is hope again. That feels like an answer.
There is more peace now than there was a few weeks ago. Thank you.
Still waiting for the heaviness to lift, but we are at peace that God is in it.
